query:
By Session 2, what pattern of attendance has the group come to anticipate from one specific member, and what in Josh's framing of the situation signals that the group has already adjusted to it?

Options:
A. Josh
B. Leon
C. Mei
D. Priya
context:
[1] (about=Josh, episodic, t1 @2025-10-13T09:02:00) Good to see you both last night 🍻 Priya you look really well. Mei, your team sounds intense. Leon didn't come again.
[2] (about=Josh, episodic, t0 @2025-10-06T14:44:00) classic Leon response 😂 we'll have your booth ready in case
[3] (about=Josh, episodic, t8 @2025-11-03T21:21:00) Great, Leon returns to the people just as the people lose faith
[4] (about=Josh, episodic, t8 @2025-11-03T20:47:00) legend. I'm still in the same chair so can't help with that 😂 come to drinks next time though Leon, genuinely
[5] (about=Leon, episodic, t8 @2025-11-03T21:03:00) ironically yes. I miss the tiny booth more than another investor dinner at this point
[6] (about=Leon, episodic, t8 @2025-11-03T21:12:00) Don't get used to it but I'd take a booth and chips over another room full of lanyards right now
[7] (about=Mei, episodic, t8 @2025-11-03T20:58:00) Anyway, next drinks. same booth strategy?
[8] (about=Josh, episodic, t0 @2025-10-06T12:08:00) Quarterly drinks! Last Thursday of the month? I've found a new place in Soho, proper booths 😁
[9] (about=Leon, episodic, t0 @2025-10-06T15:06:00) exactly. consistency matters
[10] (about=Josh, episodic, t6 @2025-10-27T19:23:00) Priya and I already talked about it properly last week, she's good 🙂 not everything needs to be a group agenda item Mei 😂
agent_answer:
B. Leon

The group has come to anticipate that Leon will not show up to gatherings. Josh signals the group has already adjusted to this by saying, “Leon didn’t come again” — the word “again” treating his absence as the expected pattern — and earlier by calling it a “classic Leon response” and saying “we’ll have your booth ready in case,” showing they plan around his likely non-attendance.
